text:
maya: FYI the nightly model-refresh + perf bench failed this morning — seeing ~20% throughput drop on refresh-v2 compared to baseline. job id: 6152. logs show repeated KV cache misses and a decode slow path. anyone grabbing this?

infra-bot: Job 6152 failed automatic check: throughput regression detected (baseline 980 toks/s -> 770 toks/s). Full run at https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/6152 · triggered: nightly/model-refresh · shard: gpu-12

liam: can you paste the smallest failing log snippet?

maya: sure — here's the core loop around the slowdown:```
[2026-03-16T03:04:12Z] decode_step duration=1.9ms (prev=0.7ms)
[2026-03-16T03:04:12Z] KVCache miss_rate=0.58 (expected ~0.12)
[2026-03-16T03:04:12Z] selected_kernel=compat_slow_path
```

tony: i'm kicking a quick rerun with smaller batch and isolated bench flags now: `/ci/rerun 6152 --bench-only --batch=1 --tag=canary`

infra-bot: Rerun queued: 6152-rerun1 (canary). Watch logs: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/6152-rerun1

sara: did we merge the model-backend runtime bump last night? i remember a kernel fallback change landed ~03:10 UTC.

maya: yes — runtime v2.3.1 rolled at 03:12 UTC (PR #3298).

liam: if rerun reproduces, we should bisect the runtime commits between v2.2.7..v2.3.1. also check tokenizers dependency — there was a tokenizer patch in staging.

nina: i noticed a tokenizers bump in infra/requirements in PR #3219 — might be worth pinning as a quick test.

tony: rerun finished — same drop. logs show KV cache miss spikes earlier in sequence and we pick compat_slow_path kernels more often. snippet:```
[2026-03-16T04:01:05Z] KVCache miss_rate=0.62
[2026-03-16T04:01:05Z] chosen_kernel=compat_slow_path (fallback reason=shard_misaligned)
[2026-03-16T04:01:05Z] throughput=760 toks/s
```

maya: ok plan proposal: 1) pin tokenizers back to previous rev and trigger a single-run smoke to rule out tokenization impact, 2) start git bisect over runtime kernel changes if (1) doesn't help, 3) collect pprof/trace from a failing run and attach to the bisect doc. i'll spin up the bisect doc and assign.

liam: i'll help with pprof capture steps and a small local reproducer. quick command for folks:```
# create small repro container
./scripts/run_local_repro.sh --model refresh-v2 --prompt-file tests/smoke/prompt.txt --batch 1 --capture-pprof /tmp/pprof.pb
```

qa-bot: reminder: if you need historical artifacts, drop them into s3://redwood-nightly/artifacts/6152 and tag with `regression-1976543210` — that preserves CI links for audits.

maya: thanks — i'll try pinning tokenizers first and update the thread. @tony can you keep 6152-rerun1 logs until we say otherwise? :eyes:

tony: yep i exported logs and uploaded to s3://redwood-nightly/artifacts/6152/6152-rerun1.log. i'll keep reruns queued but not deleting.

maya: cool. i'll open the bisect issue and ping @eng-runtime if we need infra-level kernel rollbacks. moving to async triage — will post updates here. :coffee:
